identification: Antique/vintage oak hinged canteen-style box (cutlery box, interior blue lining) with engraved brass plaque 'To Mrs Charles McFerran on the occasion of her marriage 15-11-24', used as a sewing box and containing wooden cotton reels, ribbon/lace, paste/rhinestone buttons, a gold-tone Art Deco style belt buckle, a tin, two or three pairs of scissors and misc buttons. Common-value mixed sewing job lot; the box itself is an empty-canteen type worth roughly $35-120.
marks_seen: Brass plaque engraved 'To Mrs Charles McFerran on the occasion of her marriage 15-11-24'. No maker marks legible on scissors or box.

identification: Group of 5 unmarked Australian drip-glaze art pottery pieces in green/brown/orange/blue: tall flared vase (brown base, green top, probably the 'Diana vase'), ball/swirl-ribbed vase, small two-handled pot, small waisted vase, and a curved trough planter. Style matches Diana Pottery (Marrickville NSW, 1941-66) drip glaze and Tasmanian studio pottery of the same era. No impressed or inked marks visible on any base.
marks_seen: Bases photographed (tall vase, waisted vase, small pot, ball vase, trough): no maker marks, numbers or impressed stamps legible.
